svg.title: The table for a = ABCABBA and b = CBABAC, filled a row at a time from the bottom: each cell is the length of the longest common subsequence of a from line i and b from line j
svg.text: a.txt: A B C A B B A, b.txt: C B A B A C
L[i][j], when a[i] and b[j] are equal:
otherwise, the larger of below and right:
the two lines are equal here

g.title: Row 7 first: no line of a is left there, so nothing is in common with any end of b, and every cell is 0. Column 6, the end of b, is 0 in every row for the same reason.
g.text: rows 6 to 0 are still to fill

g.title: Row 6, a's line "A": equal to b's lines 2 and 4, which take 1 more than the cell to their lower right; every other cell takes the larger of the cells below and to its right.
g.text: L[6][0]: A is not C: max(0, 1) = 1

g.title: Row 5, a's line "B": equal to b's lines 1 and 3, which take 1 more than the cell to their lower right; every other cell takes the larger of the cells below and to its right.
g.text: L[5][0]: B is not C: max(1, 2) = 2

g.title: Row 4, a's line "B": equal to b's lines 1 and 3, which take 1 more than the cell to their lower right; every other cell takes the larger of the cells below and to its right.
g.text: L[4][0]: B is not C: max(2, 3) = 3

g.title: Row 3, a's line "A": equal to b's lines 2 and 4, which take 1 more than the cell to their lower right; every other cell takes the larger of the cells below and to its right.
g.text: L[3][0]: A is not C: max(3, 3) = 3

g.title: Row 2, a's line "C": equal to b's lines 0 and 5, which take 1 more than the cell to their lower right; every other cell takes the larger of the cells below and to its right.
g.text: L[2][1]: C is not B: max(3, 3) = 3

g.title: Row 1, a's line "B": equal to b's lines 1 and 3, which take 1 more than the cell to their lower right; every other cell takes the larger of the cells below and to its right.
g.text: L[1][0]: B is not C: max(4, 4) = 4

g.title: Row 0 last. L[0][0] = 4: a and b have 4 lines in common, so diff deletes 7 - 4 = 3 of a's lines and inserts 6 - 4 = 2.
g.text: L[0][0] = 4: all of a against all of b
